description: This file declares socket-related functions for network communication, including retrieving local endpoints, converting socket addresses to string format, and parsing address strings.

methods.name: rtSocket_GetLocalEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket endpoint for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: rtSocketStorage_GetLength
methods.description: Gets the length of the socket address stored in a sockaddr_storage structure.

methods.name: rtSocketStorage_ToString
methods.description: Converts a socket address to a human-readable string, also providing the port number.

methods.name: rtSocketStorage_FromString
methods.description: Parses a string to fill a sockaddr_storage structure representing a socket address.
